case.caveats: VERBATIM NOTE: same Table 1 layout as the ndhF case - forward and reverse are two lines inside one cell, split taken at the printed line break; confirmed by the exact 101 bp in-silico match. TEMPLATE: AF101419.1 is "Cichorium intybus beta-tubulin mRNA, partial cds" - an mRNA/cDNA record, so this assay is cDNA-only; the paper does not establish genomic behaviour and any intron position in the chicory TUB gene is unknown. In-silico check: forward matches once at 118, reverse site once ending at 218; product 118..218 = 101 bp, exact, no alternative products. TUB was not among the genes the paper flagged as differing from its GenBank design sequence.
case.citation: Maroufi A, Van Bockstaele E, De Loose M. Validation of reference genes for gene expression analysis in chicory (Cichorium intybus) using quantitative real-time PCR. BMC Mol Biol. 2010;11:15. doi:10.1186/1471-2199-11-15. PMID 20156357; PMCID PMC2830926.
case.element: Non-TE control assay. Nuclear beta-tubulin used as a candidate RT-qPCR reference gene.
case.loci_justification: The pair flanks one locus on the cited template: a single insertion site, a single excision site, or a single transcript. A second product on this template would be an off-target prediction.
case.name: Chicory beta-tubulin (TUB) reference-gene RT-qPCR assay
case.where_in_paper: Table 1, row TUB: primers in the "Primer sequences (forward/reverse)" column, accession AF101419 in the "GenBank accession number" column, 101 in the "Amplicon length (bp)" column. Single-product confirmation in the "Verification of amplicons..." section (Figure 1a, Figure 1b).
case.worked_prediction_note: The entry records a worked prediction — a coordinate range, an in-silico check, or a sequence-derived length — so the expected answer was written down before the engine ran. The published size remains external, but this case was not scored blind.
